## Instalation des packages

```{r,include=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace('pak',quietly = TRUE))
  install.packages('pak')

library_list <- c('tidyverse','phyloseq','ggplot2','here','dplyr','ggalluvial','plotly','umap','tibble','tidyr','vegan','phyloseq','stringr')

if (!requireNamespace(library_list, quietly = TRUE))
  pak::pkg_install(library_list)
```

## Chargement des packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggalluvial)
library(plotly)
library(umap)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
library(phyloseq)
library(stringr)
```

## Chargement des données

```{r}
# --- Chargement des données ---
path_data <- "data/raw"
path_figs <- "results/figures"

# Métadonnées
meta_df <- read.csv(here(path_data, "metadata500_starters.csv"), row.names = 1)

# Table d'abondance - 16S
ab_16s_df <- read.csv(here(path_data, "sourdough_tab_16S.csv"), row.names = 1)

# Taxonomie - 16S
tax_16s_df <- read.csv(here(path_data, "sourdough_tax_16S.csv"), row.names = 1)

# Table d'abondance - ITS
ab_its_df <- read.csv(here(path_data, "sourdough_tab_ITS.csv"), row.names = 1)

# Taxonomie - ITS
tax_its_df <- read.csv(here(path_data, "sourdough_tax_ITS.csv"), row.names = 1)
```

## Nettoyage et création objets phyloseq

```{r}
# --- Nettoyage et Renommage de la Taxonomie ---

# 16S
tax_16s_mat <- tax_16s_df %>%
  rename(
    Kingdom = taxonomy1, Phylum = taxonomy2, Class = taxonomy3,
    Order = taxonomy4, Family = taxonomy5, Genus = taxonomy6,
    Species = taxonomy7, ASV = taxonomy8
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

# ITS 
tax_its_mat <- tax_its_df %>%
  rename(
    Kingdom = taxonomy1, Phylum = taxonomy2, Class = taxonomy3,
    Order = taxonomy4, Family = taxonomy5, Genus = taxonomy6,
    Species = taxonomy7, ASV = taxonomy8
  ) %>%
  as.matrix()

# --- Conversion en matrices pour phyloseq ---
ab_16s_mat <- as.matrix(ab_16s_df)
ab_its_mat <- as.matrix(ab_its_df)

# --- Vérification de la correspondance des IDs ---
common_samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(colnames(ab_16s_mat), colnames(ab_its_mat), rownames(meta_df)))

print(paste("Nombre d'échantillons conservés (communs 16S & ITS) :", length(common_samples)))

# On filtre les trois tables pour qu'elles soient parfaitement alignées
ab_16s_mat <- ab_16s_mat[, common_samples]
ab_its_mat <- ab_its_mat[, common_samples]
meta_df    <- meta_df[common_samples, ]

# --- Création des objets Phyloseq ---

# 16S
phylos_16s <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(ab_16s_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(tax_16s_mat),
  sample_data(meta_df)
)

# ITS
phylos_its <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(ab_its_mat, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(tax_its_mat),
  sample_data(meta_df)
)

# Nettoyage taxons vides
phylos_its <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phylos_its) > 0, phylos_its)
phylos_16s <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phylos_16s) > 0, phylos_16s)

print("--- Résumé 16s ---")
print(phylos_16s)
print("--- Résumé ITS ---")
print(phylos_its)
```

## PCoA

```{r}
# --- PCoA 16S ---
dist_mat_16s <- phyloseq::distance(phylos_16s, method = "bray")
pcoa_16s     <- ordinate(phylos_16s, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_mat_16s)

# Variance 16S
eig_16s <- pcoa_16s$values$Relative_eig
cat("16S - Variance expliquée par les 10 premiers axes:\n")
print(cumsum(eig_16s)[1:10])

n_axes_16s <- which(cumsum(eig_16s) >= 0.75)[1]
cat("16S - Nombre d'axes pour 75% variance:", n_axes_16s, "\n")

# Clustering 16S
coords_16s <- pcoa_16s$vectors[, 1:n_axes_16s]
kmeans_16s <- kmeans(coords_16s, centers = 8, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)
sample_data(phylos_16s)$Cluster <- as.factor(kmeans_16s$cluster)


# --- PCoA ITS ---
dist_mat_its <- phyloseq::distance(phylos_its, method = "bray")
pcoa_its     <- ordinate(phylos_its, method = "PCoA", distance = dist_mat_its)

# Variance ITS
eig_its <- pcoa_its$values$Relative_eig
cat("ITS - Variance expliquée par les 10 premiers axes:\n")
print(cumsum(eig_its)[1:10])

n_axes_its <- which(cumsum(eig_its) >= 0.75)[1]
cat("ITS - Nombre d'axes pour 75% variance:", n_axes_its, "\n")

# Clustering ITS
coords_its <- pcoa_its$vectors[, 1:n_axes_its]
kmeans_its <- kmeans(coords_its, centers = 10, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)
sample_data(phylos_its)$Cluster <- as.factor(kmeans_its$cluster)
```

## Elbow plot

```{r}
# --- Fonction utilitaire pour calculer le WSS ---
calculate_wss_df <- function(coordinates, max_k = 10) {
  wss <- numeric(max_k)
  for (k in 1:max_k) {
    set.seed(42)
    km_res <- kmeans(coordinates, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100) # Calcul kmeans
    wss[k] <- km_res$tot.withinss # On stocke la somme des carrés intra-cluster
  }
  return(data.frame(k = 1:max_k, wss = wss))
}

# --- 1. Préparation des données (au cas où) ---
# On s'assure d'avoir les coordonnées basées sur les axes retenus précédemment
coords_16s <- pcoa_16s$vectors[, 1:n_axes_16s]
coords_its <- pcoa_its$vectors[, 1:n_axes_its]

# --- Calcul des Elbows ---

# 16S
elbow_data_16s <- calculate_wss_df(coords_16s, max_k = 10)

# ITS
elbow_data_its <- calculate_wss_df(coords_its, max_k = 10)

# --- Plots ---

# 16S
p_elbow_16s <- ggplot(elbow_data_16s, aes(x = k, y = wss)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Elbow Plot - 16S",
       x = "Nombre de clusters (k)",
       y = "Total Within Sum of Squares")

# ITS
p_elbow_its <- ggplot(elbow_data_its, aes(x = k, y = wss)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkorange", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkorange", size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Elbow Plot - ITS",
       x = "Nombre de clusters (k)",
       y = "Total Within Sum of Squares")

print(p_elbow_16s)
print(p_elbow_its)
```

## Sankey plot : comparaison clustering 16s vs ITS 

```{r}
# --- Préparation des données ---

# Extraction des clusters
# 16S
df_clus_16s <- data.frame(
  SampleID = rownames(sample_data(phylos_16s)),
  Cluster_16S = sample_data(phylos_16s)$Cluster
)

# ITS
df_clus_its <- data.frame(
  SampleID = rownames(sample_data(phylos_its)),
  Cluster_ITS = sample_data(phylos_its)$Cluster
)

# Fusion des deux df
df_alluvial <- inner_join(df_clus_16s, df_clus_its, by = "SampleID")

df_alluvial <- df_alluvial %>%
  group_by(Cluster_16S, Cluster_ITS) %>%
  summarise(Freq = n(), .groups = "drop")

# --- Plot Alluvial ---
p_sankey <- ggplot(df_alluvial,
       aes(y = Freq, axis1 = Cluster_16S, axis2 = Cluster_ITS)) +
  
  # Lien
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Cluster_16S), width = 1/12, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Clusters
  geom_stratum(width = 1/6, fill = "grey90", color = "grey") +
  
  # Texte clusters
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Correspondance entre clustering sur 16S et sur ITS",
       y = "Nombre d'échantillons") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_sankey)
```

## UMAP

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}

# --- Fonction : calcul et formatage UMAP vers un df pour ggplot ---
run_umap_phyloseq <- function(phyloseq_obj, n_neighbors = 30, min_dist = 0.6) {
  
  # 1. Préparation des données : Normalisation Relative
  ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(phyloseq_obj, function(x) x / sum(x))
  
  # 2. Extraction de la table d'OTU (Samples en lignes, ASV en colonnes)
  otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_rel), "matrix")
  # Si les taxa sont en lignes, on transpose pour avoir les samples en lignes
  if(taxa_are_rows(ps_rel)) {
    otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
  }
  
  # 3. Parametres UMAP
  custom_config <- umap.defaults
  custom_config$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors
  custom_config$min_dist <- min_dist
  custom_config$random_state <- 42 # Seed pour avoir toujours le même dessin
  
  # 4. Exécution
  umap_res <- umap(otu_mat, config = custom_config)
  
  # 5. Df pour ggplot
  df_umap <- as.data.frame(umap_res$layout)
  colnames(df_umap) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  
  # 6. Ajout métadonnées
  meta <- as(sample_data(phyloseq_obj), "data.frame")
  meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)
  df_umap$SampleID <- rownames(df_umap)
  
  df_final <- left_join(df_umap, meta, by = "SampleID")
  
  return(df_final)
}

# --- Calcul UMAPs ---

df_umap_16s <- run_umap_phyloseq(phylos_16s)
df_umap_its <- run_umap_phyloseq(phylos_its)

# --- Plots ---

# 16S
p_umap_16s <- ggplot(df_umap_16s, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Enlève la grosse grille
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Enlève la petite grille
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), # Fond des titres de facettes en blanc
    axis.text = element_blank(), # Enlève les chiffres des axes (inutiles en UMAP)
    axis.ticks = element_blank() # Enlève les petits traits des axes
  ) +
  labs(title = "UMAP - 16S (Bactéries)",
       color = "Cluster 16S")

# ITS
p_umap_its <- ggplot(df_umap_its, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = Cluster)) +

  theme_bw() +

    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), # Fond des titres de facettes en blanc
    axis.text = element_blank(), # Enlève les chiffres des axes (inutiles en UMAP)
    axis.ticks = element_blank() # Enlève les petits traits des axes

       color = "Cluster ITS")

print(p_umap_16s)
```

## Top ASV structurants les données

```{r}
# --- Fonction : Trouver les top ASV corrélés aux axes ---
get_pcoa_drivers <- function(phyloseq_obj, pcoa_obj, n_top = 10) {
  
  # 1. Récupérer la table d'OTU normalisée
  ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(phyloseq_obj, function(x) x / sum(x))
  otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_rel), "matrix")
  if(taxa_are_rows(ps_rel)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat) 
  
  # 2. Récupérer les coordonnées
  axes_coords <- pcoa_obj$vectors[, 1:2]
  colnames(axes_coords) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
  
  # 3. Calculer les corrélations
  cor_res <- data.frame(
    ASV = colnames(otu_mat), # Ici "ASV" contient l'identifiant (ex: ASV1)
    Cor_Axis1 = numeric(ncol(otu_mat)),
    Cor_Axis2 = numeric(ncol(otu_mat)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for(i in 1:ncol(otu_mat)) {
    cor_res$Cor_Axis1[i] <- cor(otu_mat[, i], axes_coords[, "Axis1"], method = "spearman")
    cor_res$Cor_Axis2[i] <- cor(otu_mat[, i], axes_coords[, "Axis2"], method = "spearman")
  }
  
  # 4. Score d'importance
  cor_res$Importance <- (abs(cor_res$Cor_Axis1) + abs(cor_res$Cor_Axis2)) / 2
  
  # 5. Ajouter la taxonomie
  tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phyloseq_obj))
  tax_df$ASV_ID_JOIN <- rownames(tax_df)
  
  # On fait la jointure entre "ASV" (de cor_res) et "ASV_ID_JOIN" (de tax_df)
  res_final <- left_join(cor_res, tax_df, by = c("ASV" = "ASV_ID_JOIN")) %>%
    arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
    head(n_top)
  
  return(res_final)
}

# --- Drivers : 16S ---
ps_16s_filt <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phylos_16s) > 0, phylos_16s) 
drivers_16s <- get_pcoa_drivers(ps_16s_filt, pcoa_16s, n_top = 8)

print(drivers_16s %>% select(ASV, Genus, Species, Cor_Axis1, Cor_Axis2))

# --- Drivers : ITS ---
ps_its_filt <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phylos_its) > 0, phylos_its)
drivers_its <- get_pcoa_drivers(ps_its_filt, pcoa_its, n_top = 8)

print(drivers_its %>% select(ASV, Genus, Species, Cor_Axis1, Cor_Axis2))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
# --- 16S ---

# Netoyage des noms 
df_taxa_16s <- df_taxa_16s %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_Clean = str_replace_all(Genus, "g__", ""),
    Genus_Clean = str_replace_all(Genus_Clean, "__", ""),
    Species_Clean = str_replace_all(Species, "s__", ""),
    Species_Clean = str_replace_all(Species_Clean, "__", " "),
    
    PlotLabel = paste(Genus_Clean,' ', Species_Clean, "\n(", OTU, ")", sep = "")
  )

# Normalisation "Intra-ASV"
df_taxa_norm_16s <- df_taxa_16s %>%
  group_by(PlotLabel) %>%
  mutate(Max_Abundance = max(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(Normalized_Abundance = ifelse(Max_Abundance == 0 | is.na(Max_Abundance),

  ungroup()
```

## PERMANOVA

```{r}
# Variables à tester
vars_to_test <- c("Country", "StorageLocBin", "WhoMadeBin", 
                  "Starter.age.years", "FreqOpenedPerWeek", 
                  "ContainerMaterial", "Temp")

# Netoyage metadonnées
meta_full <- as(sample_data(phylos_16s), "data.frame") %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_test))

# Conversion des types
meta_full <- meta_full %>%
  mutate(
    Country           = as.factor(Country),
    StorageLocBin     = as.factor(StorageLocBin),
    WhoMadeBin        = as.factor(WhoMadeBin),
    ContainerMaterial = as.factor(ContainerMaterial),
    Starter.age.years = as.numeric(Starter.age.years),
    FreqOpenedPerWeek = as.numeric(FreqOpenedPerWeek),
    Temp              = as.numeric(Temp)
  )

# Gestion des NA
n_before <- nrow(meta_full)
meta_clean <- na.omit(meta_full)
n_after <- nrow(meta_clean)
samples_kept <- rownames(meta_clean)

cat("Échantillons initiaux :", n_before, "\n")
cat("Échantillons conservés (aucun NA) :", n_after, "\n")

# 16s
mat_16s_subset <- as.matrix(dist_mat_16s)[samples_kept, samples_kept]
dist_clean_16s <- as.dist(mat_16s_subset)

# ITS
mat_its_subset <- as.matrix(dist_mat_its)[samples_kept, samples_kept]
dist_clean_its <- as.dist(mat_its_subset)

# ---Calcul PERMANOVA ---

#16S
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat(" PERMANOVA - 16S \n")
cat("========================================\n")
# by = "margin" teste l'effet unique de chaque variable (Type III sum of squares : ANOVA III) : test chaque variable comme si elle etait la derniere a rentrer dans le modèle
permanova_16s <- adonis2(dist_clean_16s ~ ., data = meta_clean, permutations = 999, by = "margin")
print(permanova_16s)

# PERMANOVA ITS
cat("\n========================================\n")
cat(" PERMANOVA - ITS\n")
cat("========================================\n")
permanova_its <- adonis2(dist_clean_its ~ ., data = meta_clean, permutations = 999, by = "margin")
print(permanova_its)
```

## Plot PERMANOVA

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# --- Fonction : Nettoyer résultats PERMANOVA ---
clean_permanova_plot <- function(permanova_res, dataset_name) {
  df <- as.data.frame(permanova_res)
  df$Variable <- rownames(df)
  df$Percent <- df$R2 * 100
  df$Dataset <- dataset_name # Pour distinguer 16S et ITS
  
  # On catégorise : Residual vs Métadonnées
  df$Type <- ifelse(df$Variable == "Residual", "Non Expliqué (Biologique)", "Métadonnées")
  
  # On filtre la ligne "Total" qui vaut toujours 100% et écrase le reste
  df <- df %>% filter(Variable != "Total")
  
  return(df)
}

# --- Clean res PERMANOVA ---
df_res_16s <- clean_permanova_plot(permanova_16s, "16S")
df_res_its <- clean_permanova_plot(permanova_its, "ITS")

# Fusion des res
df_permanova_combined <- rbind(df_res_16s, df_res_its)

# --- 3. Le Graphique Comparatif ---
p_permanova_combined <- ggplot(df_permanova_combined, aes(x = reorder(Variable, Percent), y = Percent, fill = Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.8) +
  # Séparation 16S / ITS côte à côte
  facet_wrap(~Dataset, scales = "free_x") + 
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percent, 1), "%")), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  
  # Couleurs
  # scale_fill_manual(values = c("Métadonnées" = "#66c2a5", "Non Expliqué (Biologique)" = "grey50")) +
  
  # Esthétique
    theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Enlève la grosse grille
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Enlève la petite grille
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), # Fond des titres de facettes en blanc
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
  ) +
  labs(title = "PERMANOVA",
       subtitle = "Part de variance expliquée (R2) par chaque facteur",
       y = "Pourcentage de variance expliquée (%)",
       x = "") +
  
  # Ajustement échelle
  ylim(0, 110) 

print(p_permanova_combined)

ggsave(
  filename = here(path_figs, "p_permanova_combined.svg"),
  plot = p_permanova_combined,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  device = "svg"
)

```
